items.title: 1.11 Network Diagnostic Tools and Commands (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Diagnostic Tools and Commands' (PDF 17-18): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network diagnostic tools (network ki bimari dhoondne wale auzaar) network ke problems dhoondne ke liye istemal hote hain. Yeh internet aur network connections check karne mein madad dete hain. Yeh tools dikhate hain ke devices theek tarah communicate kar (baat kar) sakte hain ya nahi. Commands command prompt (Windows) ya terminal (Linux/macOS) mein likhi jati hain. Is se slow (sust) ya broken (toote hue) connections pehchanne mein madad milti hai.

Network troubleshooting (masla dhoond kar theek karna) network ke issues (masail) dhoondne aur theek karne ke liye kiya jata hai. Is se connection aur speed ke problems pakre jate hain. Troubleshooting mein cables, devices aur settings check hoti hain. Is se network downtime (network band rehne ka waqt) aur errors (ghaltiyan) kam hoti hain. Is se communication smooth (baghair rukawat) rehti hai. Sahi troubleshooting network ki performance behtar karti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Troubleshooting ka aasan tareeqa: pehle cable aur Wi-Fi light dekhein, phir router restart karein, phir ipconfig se IP settings dekhein, phir ping se check karein ke router aur internet tak jawab aata hai ya nahi.

blocks.prompt: Ek student IP address se websites khol sakta hai lekin naam se nahi. Ghaliban kaun si service kharab hai, aur Windows par kaun si command computer ki IP settings dikhayegi?
blocks.explanation: Ghaliban DNS (naam ko IP address mein badalne wali service) kharab hai, kyun ke connection khud kaam kar raha hai. Windows par ipconfig IP address, subnet mask aur gateway dikhati hai.

items: Diagnostic tools: network ke masail dhoondte hain; commands command prompt ya terminal mein.
Troubleshooting: cables, devices, settings check; downtime aur errors kam; performance behtar.
